amount.description: What the customer paid, GST included, in its currency.

approval_asked.description: getCustomerDeposit only: the pending request to void it.

base.description: What it came to in the base currency, at the rate it came in; absent while it cannot be recorded.

checks.description: A preview only: what stops it being recorded (✖).

date.description: The day the money came in.

fx_rate.description: The rate typed, if one was.

gst.description: The output tax it bore, in the base currency.

gst_charged.description: Whether it bore GST when received: a part payment of a standard-rated supply once the organisation is GST-registered.

held.description: What 2410 Customer deposits holds of it, in the base currency: its base amount less its GST, never revalued.

kind.description: A part payment, or a security deposit.

ledger_impact.description: getCustomerDeposit only: the lines its entry wrote: debits positive.

left.description: A posted deposit: what is left of it to deduct or refund, in its currency.

number.description: Its number from the deposit sequence (FR-ORG-04).

received.description: What a base-currency account received for a deposit in another currency.

status.description: posted once recorded; reversed by a void.

used.description: A posted deposit: what invoices have deducted or refunds have settled of it, in its currency.

version.description: The version of its content; with the status it makes the ETag.
